litter the streets: After the night market closed, plastic cups and paper bags began to litter the streets around the temple.
夜市收攤後，塑膠杯和紙袋開始弄髒廟宇周圍的街道。
be littered with errors: His report was littered with errors, so the teacher asked him to check every sentence again.
他的報告滿是錯誤，所以老師要他把每個句子再檢查一遍。
litter the floor with papers: The kids often litter the floor with papers after art class, so we always clean up together.
孩子們上完美術課後常把紙散落一地，所以我們總是一起打掃。
loan money: My uncle agreed to loan money to my parents so that they could open a small coffee shop.
我叔叔同意借錢給我爸媽，讓他們能開一家小咖啡店。
loan a painting to a museum: The rich collector decided to loan a painting to a museum so that more people could enjoy it.
那位富有的收藏家決定把一幅畫借給博物館，讓更多人能欣賞它。
take out a loan: Many young couples have to take out a loan from the bank before they can buy their first house.
許多年輕夫妻得先向銀行貸款，才能買下他們的第一間房子。
on loan: This famous statue is on loan from a museum in Paris and will be returned next spring.
這座著名的雕像是向巴黎一家博物館借來展出的，明年春天就會歸還。
locate the problem: The mechanic needed almost two hours to locate the problem in the engine of my old car.
技師花了將近兩個小時才找出我那輛舊車引擎的問題。
be located in: Our school is located in the center of the city, so it is easy to get there by MRT.
我們學校位於市中心，所以搭捷運很容易到達。
locate a missing person: The police used dogs and drones to locate a missing person who had gotten lost in the mountains.
警方動用搜救犬和無人機，找到了一名在山區迷路的失蹤者。
locate the source: Scientists are working hard to locate the source of the strange smell coming from the river.
科學家們正努力找出河裡傳來的怪味的來源。
lock horns with: The new manager often locks horns with his boss over how the company should spend its money.
新經理常為了公司該如何花錢而與老闆激烈交鋒。
lock in a price: If you book your flight today, you can lock in a price before the summer rush begins.
如果你今天就訂機票，就能在暑假旺季開始前鎖定價格。
lock up a criminal: The judge's job is to make sure the police lock up a criminal only when there is clear evidence.
法官的職責是確保警方只有在證據明確時才把罪犯關起來。
lock eyes: When the two old friends lock eyes across the crowded room, they both smile and wave.
當這兩位老朋友在擁擠的房間裡四目相對時，他們都笑著揮手。
be locked in a battle: The two tech giants have been locked in a battle over patents for years, and neither side will give up.
這兩家科技巨頭多年來為了專利陷入激戰，雙方都不肯讓步。
under lock and key: The museum keeps its most valuable jewels under lock and key in a room with no windows.
博物館把最珍貴的珠寶妥善保管在一間沒有窗戶的房間裡。
lodge a complaint: After waiting three hours for his food, the angry customer decided to lodge a complaint with the manager.
等了三個小時才上菜，那位生氣的顧客決定向經理提出申訴。
lodge an appeal: The lawyer said he would lodge an appeal because he believed the court's decision was unfair.
律師表示他會提起上訴，因為他認為法院的判決不公平。
be lodged in one's memory: The sight of the huge waves hitting the shore is lodged in my memory even after twenty years.
巨浪拍打海岸的景象即使過了二十年仍深植在我的記憶中。
lodge with a family: During her year in London, Amy chose to lodge with a family so she could practice English every day.
在倫敦的那一年，艾咪選擇寄宿在一戶人家，好讓她每天都能練習英文。
log in: You need to log in with your student number and password before you can see your test scores.
你需要用學號和密碼登入，才能看到你的考試成績。
log data: The weather station uses sensors to log data about temperature and rainfall every ten minutes.
氣象站使用感測器每十分鐘記錄一次氣溫和雨量的數據。
log the hours: Part-time workers must log the hours they work each day so that they can be paid correctly.
兼職人員必須記錄每天的工時，這樣才能拿到正確的薪水。
log off: Please remember to log off before you leave the library computer so others cannot use your account.
離開圖書館電腦前請記得登出，這樣別人就無法使用你的帳號。
keep a log: The ship's captain must keep a log of the weather, speed, and position during the whole trip.
船長在整趟航程中必須寫日誌，記錄天氣、速度和位置。
loosen restrictions: As the number of cases dropped, the government began to loosen restrictions on travel and large events.
隨著病例數下降，政府開始放寬對旅遊和大型活動的限制。
loosen one's grip: The old dictator refused to loosen his grip on power even after millions of people protested.
即使有數百萬人抗議，那位老獨裁者仍拒絕放鬆對權力的掌控。
loosen up: Before the big game, the coach told the nervous players to take a deep breath and loosen up.
大賽前，教練要緊張的球員們深呼吸、放輕鬆。
loosen one's tongue: A few glasses of wine seemed to loosen his tongue, and he began telling us all his secrets.
幾杯酒下肚似乎讓他話多了起來，他開始把所有秘密都告訴我們。
loosen the rules: Many students hope the school will loosen the rules about hairstyles and let them dye their hair.
許多學生希望學校能放寬髮型規定，讓他們可以染頭髮。
